chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who has a debt and borrows in order to perform hajj. He said: “If he has a means in wealth, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.دَيْنٌ: A debt owed by a person.
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: There is no harm or objection in it.
key_terms.وَجْهٌ: A financial means or viable basis for repayment.
key_terms.يَسْتَقْرِضُ: He borrows money as a loan.

ai.seo_question: Can a person who is in debt borrow money to perform hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a person in debt who wishes to borrow money for hajj. Imam Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام states that there is no harm in doing so if the person has a financial means or basis by which repayment is feasible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2902 - It was narrated from Abdul-Malik ibn Utbah, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (as) about a man who has debt but borrows money to perform Hajj.
Imam (as) said: "If he has a means to repay the debt, there is no harm in it."
